message: Coordination: Worker 3's unintegrated admin-state revision 94aef9b1 currently calls LedgerBindingConfig.load + LedgerStore.transact before nearly every ordinary Working-agent tool call, including reads. Lead flagged this as a scalability/availability issue and asked Worker 3 to reconsider. When validating trust-binding contention, include concurrent verified ledger reads/writes and long remote fetches, but do not assume this per-call write design will be integrated. Preserve short lock critical sections and a responsive Agents screen.
